caption: A stack of textbooks is balanced on the palm of a hand; the hand tilts to one side, and the books slide off and fall to the floor.

sa.check: A stack of textbooks is balanced on the palm of a hand.
The hand tilts to one side.
Several books are stacked rather than one.
The tilt comes first, then the slide, then the fall.

pc.expect: The books slide toward the low side of the hand and fall from there.
pc.fail: They slide toward the high side; or they stay on the tilted palm; or they lift off the hand.

pc.expect: Once off the hand they drop to the floor and stay there.
pc.fail: They hang in the air; or rise; or land and re-stack.

pc.expect: The books stay put on the level palm and move only as the tilt grows.
pc.fail: They slide before the hand tilts; or they move again after landing; or they jump off as a block while the hand is level.

pc.expect: The books stay rigid, may fan open, and clatter on the floor.
pc.fail: They bend like rubber; or bounce high; or splash.

pc.expect: The books keep their number and pass through nothing.
pc.fail: Books vanish or multiply; or a book passes through the hand; or a book turns into another object.

pc.expect: The books' covers, the hand and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: A cover changes colour; or the hand changes; or the room rearranges between frames.

note: The hand is kept as the balancing surface; the person behind it is not judged.
